steps.name: list the operations
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import runpy, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.deps'); sys.argv = ['list_operations.py']; runpy.run_path('list_operations.py', run_name='__main__')"
steps.expect_stdout:
Tasks and Teams API 1.0.0 (OpenAPI 3.1.1)
GET    /health  getHealth  [public]
GET    /v1/tasks/{taskId}  getTask  [team-member-or-admin]

steps.name: exercise solution
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import runpy, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '../../code/.deps'); sys.argv = ['list_responses.py', '../../code/mini-openapi.yaml']; runpy.run_path('list_responses.py', run_name='__main__')"
steps.expect_stdout:
GET /health: 200, 503
  security: no token needed
GET /v1/tasks/{taskId}: 200, 304, 401, 403, 404
  security: scope tasks:read
